name: EPIC 206517079
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.7 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,336 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.95 solar masses and 7.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,586 K at its surface.
